newsitem.title: USA: Three workers found dead in Washington coffee shop.
newsitem.headline: Three workers found dead in Washington coffee shop.

text.p: Three employees of a Starbucks coffee shop in Washington's posh Georgetown area were found shot to death Monday, police said.

Two men and a woman, all with gunshot wounds to the head, were discovered shortly after 5:15 a.m. EDT by an employee coming to work, police said. The store had closed at 8 p.m. Sunday, but it was not known when the three died.
Police shut down busy Wisconsin Avenue near the scene of the shooting while they examined the shop during the morning rush hour.
"We're trying to develop a motive and possible suspects," Sgt. Joe Gentile said in a television interview/
The victims were not identified, but television reports said they were all in their 20s.
